title: Michael’s Birthday
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael's coworkers celebrate his birthday with various events including a traditional chair hoisting and a group gift. Michael attempts to recruit coworkers into selling calling cards, which others suspect is a pyramid scheme. Kevin faces concern over a possible skin cancer diagnosis, with Michael offering support and planning to take him away from the sun. Michael shares personal birthday memories, and the office comes together to make the day special despite underlying worries.
